title: A few complaints but not terrible for the price
text: A few complaints but not terrible for the price. Bed is great for my toddler. The pieces aren't very strong. We have already had to glue a drawer back together. The handles are kind of sharp and we took them off the bed before they cut my kids leg while sliding off bed. Also one of the pieces had the holes drilled wrong but I called the supplier on the phone and the immediately fixed the problem and sent a new part. Overall not bad for the price but also not the greatest
